newsitem.title: LATVIA: VENTSPILS PUBLIC OFFER TO START AUGUST 20.
newsitem.headline: VENTSPILS PUBLIC OFFER TO START AUGUST 20.

text.p: The Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) said on Wednesday that the public offer for Ventspils Nafta will begin on August 20.

"The signing of the merger agreement between pipeline operator Lasam and Ventspils Nafta oil terminal could be signed around July 7," Janis Naglis, general director of the LPA, told a news conference.
"We could thus hope to arrange the first public offer stage of 10 million shares around August 20," he said.
"The Riga stock exchange's capitalisation has to reach one billion dollars and that could be done only by listing one of the big companies," Naglis said.
"That could be Ventspils Nafta, which we could see on the bourse by the new year," he added.
Ventspls Nafta share sale is planed to take place via a mix of public offers and placements abroad.
Some 15.5 million shares of Ventspils will be sold through a public offer and the company's capital after privatisation is to rise from 30 million lats to 200 million lats.
